assumptions: Local verification only; release sign-off does not deploy the application.

criteria.AC-001: POST /api/v1/shorten accepts a valid destination and returns 201 with a code and shortUrl. A supplied alias resolves to its stored destination.
criteria.AC-002: GET /{code} redirects a live link (302), rejects an unknown code (404) and rejects an expired link (410). HEAD /{code} does not increment redirect counts.
criteria.AC-003: GET /api/v1/stats/{code} reports the stored destination and redirect count; /health reports UP. Preserve the legacy link, preview and aggregate stats endpoints.

Build the approved checkout with the Maven wrapper and `clean verify`.
